43:61.text: shall be a known sign for
Therefore have no doubt concerning it
(i.e. be obedient to Allâh and do what He orders you to do, O mankind)
(of Islâmic Monotheism, leading to Allâh and to His Paradise)

43:62.text: (from the right religion, i.e. Islâmic Monotheism)
to you is a plain enemy.

43:63.text: clear Proofs, he said: "I have come to you with Al-Hikmah
, and in order to make clear to you some of the
in which you differ. Therefore fear Allâh and obey me.

43:64.text: (i.e. Allâh’s religion of true Islâmic Monotheism)

43:65.text: But the sects from among themselves differed. So woe to those who do wrong
[by ascribing things to ‘Îsâ (Jesus) that are not true]
from the torment of a painful Day

43:66.text: Do they only wait for the Hour that it shall come upon them suddenly, while they perceive not?

43:67.text: Friends on that Day will be foes one to another except Al-Muttaqûn

43:68.text: (It will be said to the true believers of Islâmic Monotheism)
: My worshippers! No fear shall be on you this Day, nor shall you grieve,

43:69.text: (i.e. who submit totally to Allâh’s Will, and believe in the Oneness of Allâh - Islâmic Monotheism)

43:70.text: Enter Paradise, you and your wives, in happiness.

43:71.text: Trays of gold and cups will be passed round them;
therein all that inner-selves could desire, and all that eyes could delight in and you will abide therein forever.

43:72.text: This is the Paradise which you have been made to inherit because of your deeds which you used to do

43:73.text: Therein for you will be fruits in plenty, of which you will eat
